title: Weeping Creaks
body:
# Weeping Angels in Minecraft 24w40a (Winter Drop)

### To spawn a Weeping Angel just rename a Creaking to one of the following:
- weeping
- Weeping
- angel
- Angel
- Weeping Angel
- weeping angel

Don't forget to download the Resource Pack from here: [Weeping Creaks RP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/weeping-creaks-rp)
